static_traits.name: Han Sikai
static_traits.social_status: Small social circle, difficulty opening up to friends about insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar problems; no history of psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; cautious tone, skeptical but willing to cooperate; frequent use of negative predictions and Self-deprecation expressions; able to set small goals under Guidance (e.g., starting with threading a needle)

basic_info.main_problem: Developed feelings of self-inadequacy and Self-doubt about sewing skill, believing no amount of practice will make it better; initially triggered by comparison with others, now developed into avoiding sewing and feeling Depression.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these Self-doubt feelings are affecting my enjoyment of sewing and causing pain, so I seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am a 'not good enough / not capable enough' person
No matter how I practice, it will not get better

special_situations.event: Watches online sewing tutorials and sees others' high-quality works
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly reach the level shown in tutorials, it means I have no talent and I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly browses tutorials and comparisons, seeks others' recognition, but reduces actual practice to avoid setbacks again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how long I practice, I cannot reach their level

special_situations.event: Trying to make a 'seemingly simple' tote bag but the result was not ideal
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do even simple projects well, it proves I will never do well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopped using the sewing machine, completely avoiding sewing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do even something this simple well; I am just not good enough; I will never learn

special_situations.event: Sees others' sewing projects or finished products (online/offline)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by doing as well as others or even better can I count as 'good enough / qualified'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing on others' strengths and my own inadequacy, reducing willingness to ask for help and communicate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone else is far stronger than me; I am far inferior to them

special_situations.event: Merely thinking about restarting sewing or preparing to start practicing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail once more, it will prove again that I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding starting tasks through preemptive negation and Withdrawal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once it starts it will be terrible; I will fail again

core_conflict.wish: Longs for competence and recognition (hopes to show ability through sewing and gain affirmation)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated after comparison, accompanied by shame and inferiority
defense_goal: Relieves feelings of failure and shame by avoiding sewing
Preemptively defends against external evaluation through self-deprecation

object_relations.object_representation: Others/tutorials are harsh judges and out-of-reach experts

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes establishing graded tasks and gradual exposure exercises
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing this will be ineffective for me and I will fail in the end (experiencing the counselor's advice as external standards/Demands of 'cannot help me')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt in a calm but negative tone (e.g., 'this may be useless' 'the process is too long to be effective'), making fewer commitments, emphasizing difficulties and uncertainty.

manifestations: Difficulty opening up to friends about insecurity and Self-doubt
Feeling that others 'do not understand why sewing troubles me'
outcomes: Heightened Low mood and feelings of helplessness
Reduces connection with others about interests/difficulties
Further avoiding sewing and expressing needs

manifestations: Sewing, once a hobby, has lost its joy, the experience eroded by Self-doubt
outcomes: Withdrawal from interests, lack of achievement
Heightened doubt about self-worth, daily emotions affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not good enough' 'I will never learn')
Difficulty expressing unease to friends, worrying about not being understood
Over-scrutinizing my own inadequacy when facing practice tasks and therefore not taking action

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Avoiding direct engagement in practice with doubt and negation ('this may be useless')
No longer touching the sewing machine after failure experiences
Turns attention to comparison and prediction rather than present experience and practice

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Presses the urge to practice back and criticizes myself (stops sewing, inner criticism intensifies)
Rarely seeking effective guidance or breaking tasks down, instead 'enduring it' and Withdrawing

positive_force: Has stable Work and basic executive function; daily functioning not yet affected
Willing to try graded tasks and gradual exposure in counseling (starting from low-difficulty tasks such as threading a needle)
Able to identify trigger factors (watching tutorials, comparing with others, thinking about starting)
Has some external support (a few friends to talk to)
negative_force: Habitual comparison and Self-denial, relying on external validation
Catastrophizing and overgeneralization; all-or-nothing thinking causing difficulty starting
Avoiding sewing to escape failure and shame, reinforcing the problem cycle
Limited social circle, difficulty expressing unease, limited support mobilization

antecedent: Trying to sew or merely thinking about starting
Watches online tutorials, sees others' high-quality works
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing 'no amount of practice will make it better', using avoidance to ease feelings of failure and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome emotions (feelings of failure, shame and Anxiety)
target_behavior.consequence: Loss of interest and pleasure, increased Low mood and Sense of frustration, subjective Decline in sense of well-being in daily life
